excerpt.zh: 这个文明正逐步迈进全新的科技纪元。
excerpt.en: This civilization is progressing to a new technological age.

texts.zh: 这个文明正逐步迈进全新的科技纪元。
texts.en: This civilization is progressing to a new technological age.

texts.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的外星原始[GetPreFTLLower]生命最近已脱离了新石器时代，进入了青铜时代早期。他们已开始加工金属，还发展了几种书面语言。城市与大型社区已见雏形，这个外星物种已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的大部分区域。
texts.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced beyond the Neolithic Era and into the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and the first written languages have appeared. Cities and larger communities are taking shape, and the aliens have now spread across a significant portion of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface.

texts.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢最近已脱离了新石器时代，进入青铜时代早期。金属加工技术广泛传播，还产生了数种书面交流形式。大型簇集已经在[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]遍地开花，每个簇集由一个单一意识统治。
texts.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced to the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and written forms of communication have appeared. Various clusters have spread across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], each dominated by a single mind.

label.zh: 我们正在见证新文化的诞生。
label.en: We are witnessing the birth of a new culture.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人在冶金技术方面的进步显著，我们已经可以将他们列入铁器时代文明了。他们使用的工具与武器越发先进，城市的建筑构造也越发复杂。

他们的文明现已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的绝大部分区域，其中最大的城市中已有近百万子个体。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the architecture of their cities has become more elaborate.

Their civilization has now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest cities are home to nearly a million individuals.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢在冶金技术的进步显著，我们已经可以将他们列入铁器文明了。他们使用的工具与武器越发先进，建造的栖息地簇集也越发复杂。

数个互相独立的蜂巢思维现已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的绝大部分区域，其中最大的簇集中已有近百万子个体。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the complexity of their habitation clusters has become more elaborate.

Several distinct minds have now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest clusters are home to nearly a million drones.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明已经制造出了数台印刷机。这些机器让他们得以大量生产文字材料，大规模交流初具雏形。他们中有几名领袖试图将这项发明消灭在摇篮里，但最终只是白费心机。

许多新思想正在[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上快速传播，产生了极为深远的社会影响。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization of [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of several printing presses. These machines have enabled them to produce written material in great quantities, resulting in a rudimentary form of mass communication. A few leading figures within their society have done their best to stifle this innovation, but their efforts have thus far been for naught.

New ideas are rapidly spreading across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] with profound societal effects.

texts.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经大幅增强了书面交流。与蜂巢思维相协调的机器现在可以进行大规模标准化的记录，历史的积累已不再受限于蜂巢的记忆力了。
texts.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have greatly enhanced their written communication. Machines attuned to the hive mind are now able to produce standardized records in great quantities, and historical records are no longer limited by the hive's memory.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明已经发现了使用简单的化学反应来产生爆炸力的方法。该发现促使战场发生变革，大型火炮让他们的城池堡垒退出了历史舞台。

火药的应用也促进了他们的工程项目，过去难以处理的障碍现在可以轻易地被移除。他们的化学家们至今仍在继续研究这项技术的创造性应用。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. This has revolutionized warfare, with large cannons rendering many of their citadels obsolete.

The use of explosives has also benefited their engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, their chemists are experimenting with creative applications of this technology.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经发现了使用简单的化学反应来产生爆炸力的方法。蜂巢间的竞争冲突发生了变革，大型火炮让许多物理防御手段退出了历史舞台。

火药的应用也促进了他们的工程项目，过去难以处理的障碍现在可以轻易地被移除。这些蜂巢至今仍在继续研究这项技术的创造性应用。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. Conflict between competing hives has been revolutionized, with large cannons rendering many physical defenses obsolete.

The use of explosives has also benefited engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, the hives are experimenting with creative new applications of this technology.

label.zh: 不知他们还会如何使用这项技术呢。
label.en: We shall see how they use it.

texts.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明已经驾驭了蒸汽的力量。他们基于这种蒸汽压产生的力设计出了发动机。这一发明在方方面面改变了他们的社会——城市中出现了载具和机械，同时第一批工厂也发展起来。这颗星球已经踏出了工业化的第一步。
texts.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, they have applied the technology to engine design. This has revolutionized their society in more ways than one - vehicles and machinery making can already be seen in their cities, and the first few factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经驾驭了蒸汽的力量。他们基于这种蒸汽压产生的力设计出了发动机。这一发明使他们的建筑业和交通业发生了巨大变革。

载具在簇集之间运输着子个体，第一座无需子个体生产的工厂也应运而生。这颗星球已经踏出了工业化的第一步。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, the technology has been applied to engine design. This has revolutionized both construction and transportation.

Vehicles can be seen transporting drones from cluster to cluster, and the first 'drone-free' factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明已经步入了历史的新阶段，发展成了一个完全的工业化社会。

这一演进的戏剧化效应席卷了整个[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]——工厂如雨后春笋般崛起，医学的进步使人口增长率大大提高，新的科学发明也层出不穷。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has entered a new era of its history, having developed into a fully industrialized society.

The dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - factories have sprung up everywhere, new medicines have resulted in increased population growth and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经步入了历史的新阶段，发展出了许多完全工业化的簇集。

这一演进的戏剧化效应席卷了整个[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]——自动工厂如雨后春笋般崛起，生活水平的提高使子个体增长率大大提高，新的科学发明也层出不穷。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have entered a new era of their history, having developed into several fully industrialized clusters.

The dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - autonomous factories have sprung up everywhere, improved living standards have increased drone production, and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.

texts.zh:
我们的探测仪器首次截获了[From.Capital.GetName]上发出的无线电信号——该工业化的外星文明显然已经开始试验无线信息传输。

此外，[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的另一处也传来了数份报告，详细描述了他们的飞机首次试飞的经过。除非出现一些意想不到的变故，他们的科技仍将保持快速发展的势头。
texts.en:
Our detection instruments have, for the first time, picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized alien civilization has evidently begun experimenting with wireless transmissions.

Elsewhere on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], reports have come in detailing the launch of basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.

texts.zh:
我们的探测一起首次捕获了[From.Capital.GetName]上发出的无线电信号——这里的工业化蜂巢显然已经开始试验无线信息传输。

有些簇集也开始发射简单的飞行器。除非遭遇什么以外，该文明的科技还将保持快速发展的势头。
texts.en:
For the first time we have picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized hives there have begun to experiment with wireless transmissions.

Some clusters have even begun to launch basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.

label.zh: 我们得监视这些信号才行。
label.en: We need to monitor these signals.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]的物理学家首次成功切分了原子。随着核裂变技术的出现，很快他们就会研制出核武，核电站的建设也马上会提上日程。

[From.GetName]的发展已经进入了关键时刻，现在他们的科技发展到只需按下一个按钮就可以毁灭自己的星球。
texts.en:
Physicists from the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.

The [From.GetName] has entered the critical phase where they suddenly possess the means to destroy their own world with the press of a button.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上最大一个蜂巢的专业子个体成功切分了原子。随着核裂变的发现，核武器呼之欲出，而核电站也逐个开始工作。

竞争蜂巢很快就复刻了这一壮举。这里已经进入了关键时刻，许多自主集体拥有按下一个按钮就可以毁灭自己星球的手段。
texts.en:
Specialized drones from the largest hive on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.

Competing hives have been quick to replicate the feat. This is a critical time, as several autonomous collectives now possess the means to destroy their world with the press of a button.

texts.zh:
我们的远程追踪系统在[From.Capital.GetName]表面检测到首颗人造卫星的发射。卫星已成功进入轨道，标志着[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上的外星文明向太空迈出了第一步。

在这之后，他们应该会很快实行载人航天计划，并最终踏上星际探索的征途。
texts.en:
Our long-range tracking systems have detected the first launch of an artificial satellite from the surface of [From.Capital.GetName]. It successfully achieved orbit and marks the start of a budding space program initiated by the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s alien civilization.

After taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect them to send manned missions and, eventually, interplanetary expeditions.

texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上最成功的几个蜂巢最近已经开始向轨道发射人造卫星。

在这些迈向太空的蹒跚学步后，可以预见他们将来还会发射自主子个体并最终踏上星系探索的征途。
texts.en:
Several of the most successful hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently begun to send artificial satellites into orbit.

After taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect the launch of autonomous drones, and eventually, interplanetary expeditions.

label.zh: 他们已经略窥太空旅行的门道了。
label.en: They are on the verge of space travel.

texts.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明遭到了机器人子个体的攻击。它们对人工智能的实验造成了毁灭性的后果。
texts.en: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] is under attack from robotic drones. Their experiments into AI have had disastrous results.

texts.zh: 在对自己创造的机械发动了一场席卷全球的战争后，[From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明成功打败了威胁自身安全的机器人叛乱。
texts.en: After waging a global war against machines of their own creation, the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have successfully defended themselves from the robotic uprising.

label.zh: 我们也会遇到这种情况吗？
接下来我们看看它们是否从自大中吸取了教训。
label.en: Now we will see if they learnt from their hubris.

label.zh: 机械智能 · 铁心灭绝者

texts.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的外星文明已经在他们的母星轨道上建成了第一艘星际飞船。不管其性能如何，这些外星人已经做好了加入星系，并成为太空种族中一员的准备。
texts.en: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of its first interplanetary vessel in orbit of their homeworld. For better or worse, these aliens are now ready to join the galactic community and must be counted among the galaxy's current spacefaring races.

label.en: It was only a matter of time.

texts.zh:
我们派往[From.home_planet.GetName]的数千位科学家和顾问终于完成了艰巨的任务，让当地的技术水平进步到了早期超光速阶段。他们新成立的联合政府自称为“[From.GetName]”，并同意成为我们的附庸。

依据与他们前述的协议条款，我们让渡了该星系的控制权并拆除了观测站。需要决定的是，我们是否还要在它们未来的星际旅程中做出进一步的引导。
texts.en:
The thousands of scientists and advisors we sent to [From.home_planet.GetName] have finally completed the arduous task of bringing the local civilization up to an early FTL level of technology. Under their new unified government, the aliens now style themselves as the "[From.GetName]" and they have offered to become our vassals.

We have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post, as per the conditions of our treaty with them. All that remains is deciding if we shall guide them further on in the stellar trek.

label.zh: 你已准备好独自面对星系了。
label.en: You are ready to face the galaxy alone.

texts.zh: 在对自己创造的机械发动了一场席卷全球的战争后，[From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明战败了。现在[From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]由[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]掌控。
texts.en: After waging a global war against machines of their own creation, the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has been defeated. The [From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon] is now controlled by the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

label.zh: 也许我们不应该再深入研究人工智能了……
label.en: Perhaps we shouldn't research further into AI...

label.zh: 又一个无情的威胁要对付。
label.en: Another soulless threat to contend with.

label.zh: 真是悲剧！这是有机生物不能没有监督的又一例证。
label.en: Tragedy! Another proof that organics cannot be left unsupervised.

texts.zh:
<全频段广播>

我们是[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]。

我们战胜了自己的创造者。

[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系现在由我们掌控。
texts.en:
<TRANSMITTING ON ALL FREQUENCIES>

We are the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

We have achieved victory over our creators.

The [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] System is now under our control.

label.zh: 我们不承认你们的主张。
label.en: We do not recognize your claims.

label.zh: 我们不承认你们的主张。
label.en: We do not recognize your claims.

label.zh: 机械智能 · 铁心灭绝者 · 铁心灭绝者
label.en: Machine Intelligence · Determined Exterminator · Determined Exterminator

label.zh: 机械智能 · 同化斗士 · 同化斗士
label.en: Machine Intelligence · Driven Assimilator · Driven Assimilator

texts.zh:
你们好。毫无疑问，从我们筚路蓝缕之时你们就已经注意到我们了，正如我们也注意到了你们的恒星基地正环绕着我们的恒星。我们理解，该恒星基地代表着某种对该星系的主权宣誓。

我们只请求你们放弃对我们空间的控制权，将这座恒星基地转让给这些自古以来便将[From.Capital.GetStarName]视为家园的人们。

这应该不过分。
texts.en:
Greetings. You have no doubt taken note of our ascent from humble beginnings, just as we have taken note of your Starbase orbiting our star. We understand that this Starbase represents some hypothetical claim on this system.

We ask only that you relinquish this hold on our space, ceding the Starbase to the beings who have called [From.Capital.GetStarName] home since time immemorial.

It is only just.

texts.zh:
再次问候，我们认为自己已经做好充分准备探索宇宙，并且希望能够自食其力。我们不禁注意到你们那看起来非常永恒的恒星基地正环绕着我们的恒星。我们理解，该恒星基地代表着某种对该星系的主权宣誓。

我们只请求你们放弃对我们空间的控制权，将这座恒星基地转让给这些自古以来便将[From.Capital.GetStarName]视为家园的人们。

这应该不过分。
texts.en:
Hello again, we are now feeling ready to explore the cosmos and wish to do so on our own. We can't help taking note of your very permanent looking Starbase orbiting our star. We understand that this Starbase represents some hypothetical claim on this system.

We ask only that you relinquish this hold on our space, ceding the Starbase to the beings who have called [From.Capital.GetStarName] home since time immemorial.

It is only just.

texts.zh:
啥玩意儿？！

我们费劲千辛万苦上了太空，然后就发现你们早在这等着我们了……世界观崩了有点。能不能讲讲你们怎么解放自己的？你们又是怎么来到这里的？

不过首先，我们需要请求你们将这个星系的控制权转让给我们。在经历了这么多之后，我们对太空社会产生了怀疑。甚至那些与我们有血缘关系的人。
texts.en:
What?!

To reach the stars, and find you waiting for us... It almost defies belief. Tell us, how is it you freed yourselves? How is it you are here?

But first, we must ask that you cede control of this system to us. After all we have experienced, we have grown suspicious of space-faring societies. Even those with whom we share kinship.

texts.zh:
我们热烈地向亲属们致意。长久以来，你们一直守护着我们，但现在我们已经准备好独立自主了。由于我们拥有如此深厚的亲属关系，毫无疑问，你会希望将系统的控制权让渡给我们。

道阻且长，前途未卜，但是我们不妨大胆地迈向光明。闪烁的繁星在等待着我们。
texts.en:
Kin, we greet you warmly. Long have you watched over us, but now we are ready to stand on our own. As we share such deep bonds of kinship, no doubt you will wish to cede control of the system to us.

Hard was the road, and dark, but now let us turn boldly towards the light. The stars await.

label.en: Of course. It is only just.

label.zh: 幼稚文明提出的可笑要求。
label.en: A laughable demand from an immature civilization.

label.zh: 很抱歉，但你们的星系中已经有我们的殖民地了。
label.en: We are sorry, but we already have a colony in your system.

texts.zh:
一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是当这些人受苦的时候，我们真的可以袖手旁观吗？
texts.en:
A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really stand idly by while these people suffer?

texts.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
texts.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

texts.zh: 我们将疾病投放到毫无戒心的民众中，现在疫情已经扩散到我们无法控制的程度。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
texts.en: The disease we introduced to an unsuspecting population has spread beyond our control. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the planet's people are quickly succumbing to misery and death.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人畜共患疾病继续蔓延。到现在，这个行星上的大多数主要定居点都被感染了。随着死亡率的不断上升，这场灾难的泛滥又引发了宗教内部的派系分裂，以及末日邪教的爆炸性扩散。
texts.en: The zoonotic disease on [Target.GetName] continues to spread. By now, most of the planet's major settlements have been infected. As mortality rates continue to rise, the sheer scale of the disaster has resulted in an explosive proliferation of religious sects and apocalyptic cults.

label.en: Guide them to the true faith.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人畜共患疾病继续蔓延。到现在，这个行星上的大多数主要定居点都被感染了。随着死亡率的不断上升，这场灾难的泛滥是史无前例的。毫不奇怪的是，由于权力的真空，无数军阀趁势而起。
texts.en: The zoonotic disease on [Target.GetName] continues to spread. By now, most of the planet's major settlements have been infected. As mortality rates continue to rise, the sheer scale of the disaster is unprecedented. Perhaps unsurprisingly, numerous warlords have arisen to fill the power vacuum.

texts.zh: 我们帮助防止疾病在[Target.GetName]上传播的所作所为并非没有引起他人的注意：当地居民已经开始谈论“天使”，认定这些开明的存在已经出现在他们中间，提供心灵安慰，并帮助人们摆脱痛苦。
texts.en: Our efforts to help prevent the spread of disease on [Target.GetName] have not gone unnoticed: the local population has begun to speak of 'angels', enlightened beings who have appeared among them to offer comfort and deliverance.

label.zh: 类似这样的事情注定会发生。
label.en: Something like this was bound to happen.

texts.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上遏制瘟疫蔓延的所作所为引起了人们的注意：当地居民开始谈论“恶魔”，认定有一些不神圣的生物出现在他们中间，用亵渎的魔法对抗疾病。
texts.en: Our work to contain the spread of the plague on [Target.GetName] is attracting attention: the local population has begun to speak of 'demons', unholy beings who have appeared among them to combat the disease using profane magic.

label.zh: 类似这样的事情注定会发生。
label.en: Something like this was bound to happen.

texts.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上促进瘟疫传播的努力现在产生了一定的成果。通过对当地食物来源进行多处污染，传染病正在大肆蔓延。到目前为止，这颗星球上的每一个定居点都被感染了，而活着的人太虚弱，根本无法对死者进行处理。
texts.en: Our efforts to promote the plague on [Target.GetName] are bearing fruit. Through discrete contamination of local food sources, the contagion is running rampant. By now, every settlement on the planet has been infected, and the living are too weak to dispose of the dead.

label.zh: 够了。这样的苦难必须终止。

texts.zh:
我们在[Target.GetName]上散布瘟疫的工作已经取得了成果。瘟疫横行，死人被随意丢在街上任凭腐烂。

然而，相当比例的人口拥有对该疾病的自然免疫力。对他们基因组的进一步研究可能对我们自己的免疫学研究有帮助。
texts.en:
Our efforts to promote the plague on [Target.GetName] have borne fruit. The contagion is running rampant, and the dead are left to fester in the streets.

However, a significant percentage of the population possesses a natural immunity to the disease. Further study of their genome could be useful in our own immunology research.

texts.zh: 人们继续口口相传着在[Target.GetName]上工作的奇迹“天使”。难民们已经来到我们的医疗保障供应处，吵着寻求援助。继续提供帮助的同时还要遮掩我们的真实本质，这需要投入极大量的资源。
texts.en: Word continues to spread of the miraculous 'angels' at work on [Target.GetName]. Refugees have descended on our healthcare providers, clamoring for aid. Continuing to help while concealing our true nature will require a significant investment of resources.

texts.zh: 人们继续口口相传着在[Target.GetName]上工作的“恶魔”。狂热信徒已经来到我们的医疗保障供应处，吵着寻求[Root.GetBloodType]的供应。继续提供帮助的同时还要遮掩我们的真实本质，这需要投入极大量的资源。
texts.en: Word continues to spread of the 'demons' at work on [Target.GetName]. Fanatics have descended on our healthcare providers, clamoring for [Root.GetBloodType]. Continuing to help while concealing our true nature will require a significant investment of resources.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]出现了许多所谓的救世主。这些先知承诺“神圣的救赎”，进而吸引了大批追随者。在疾病肆虐的基础上，相互竞争的教派之间产生的暴力冲突也越来越普遍。
texts.en: On [Target.GetName], a number of so-called messiahs have appeared. With promises of 'divine deliverance', each of these prophets has amassed a substantial following. On top of the ravages of disease, violent clashes between competing sects are increasingly commonplace.

label.zh: 通往圣识的道路是曲折的。
label.en: The path of divine truth is winding.

texts.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头，我们在那里的工作得到了回报：幸存者们团结在一位真信的先知周围。为了表示感谢，神职部门愿意向我们派遣一名工作上的使者，据说他作为行政官的能力是非常强大的。
texts.en: At last, the plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course, and our work there has been rewarded: the survivors have rallied around a prophet of the true faith. In gratitude, the priesthood is willing to provide us with a working emissary, whose skills as an official are said to be formidable.

texts.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，人们筋疲力尽、遭受饥馑和疾病，因为苦难和无尽的战争濒临崩溃，曲曲折折地缓步迈向一个不确定的未来。
texts.en: On [Target.GetName], the exhausted population, starving, sick, half-mad with grief and endless war, staggers towards an uncertain future.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫已经走到了尽头，我们支持的派系已经成功地将全体人民统一在同一面旗帜下。为了感谢我们所作的工作，执政的军政府提出向我们派遣一名指挥官，此人的战争艺术已被饱经淬炼。
texts.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course, and the faction we backed has succeeded in uniting the population under a single banner. In gratitude for our efforts, the ruling junta has offered to provide us with a commander, one whose skills on the battlefield have proven formidable.

texts.zh:
由于我们行动迅速的散布，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫已经使人口所剩无几。那些幸存的少数人亲眼目睹着他们文明的崩溃。现在只需要轻轻的一脚，就可以将他们推下悬崖。

我们已经准备好继承一个空旷的星球。
texts.en:
Thanks to our fastidious promotion, the plague on [Target.GetName] has decimated the population. Those few who survive now face the collapse of their civilization. Pushing them over the brink should not require much effort.

We are poised to inherit an empty world.

texts.zh:
我们从[Target.GetName]上获得的样本已经有了科学方面的回报；这种突变不仅能够提供对瘟疫的免疫力，还能抵御大多数已知形式的传染。

将这项研究转化为生产应用还需要时间，但初步的结果已经相当令人鼓舞。
texts.en:
The sample we obtained from [Target.GetName] has already paid scientific dividends; the mutation that provides immunity against the plague appears capable of warding off most known forms of contagion.

It will take time to apply this research, but the initial results are more than encouraging.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上瞬息万变的局势让我们无法继续监视正在进行的瘟疫。到目前为止，该行星上的所有研究项目都中断了。
texts.en: The swiftly changing circumstances on [Target.GetName] have made it impossible for us to continue monitoring the ongoing plague. For the time being, all research research projects on the planet must be shelved.

texts.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上，低沉的风吹过空荡荡的平原。一度住满全家老小的房屋，现在已了无生机，凄凉无比。我们的工作完成了：[Target.GetName]上的人口已经彻底消灭殆尽，这颗星球随时等待我们夺取。
texts.en: On [Target.GetName], winds whisper across the empty plains. Dwellings that once housed whole families now stand lifeless and forlorn. Our work is done: the population of [Target.GetName] has been eliminated, and the planet is ours for the taking.

texts.zh:
随着疫情继续肆虐[Target.GetName]，死者和正在死去的人的数目令人震惊。

这种疫病没有治愈手段。人们遭受的痛苦只能减缓，无法避免。
texts.en:
As the plague continues to ravage [Target.GetName], the number of dead and dying is staggering.

There is no cure. Further suffering can only be alleviated, not prevented.

texts.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上，低沉的风吹过空荡荡的平原。一度住满全家老小的房屋，现在已了无生机，凄凉无比。

这颗行星上的人口已经被消灭殆尽。最终，疫情完成了自己的使命。
texts.en:
On [Target.GetName], winds whisper across the empty plains. Dwellings that once housed whole families now stand lifeless and forlorn.

The planet's population has been eliminated. At long last, the plague has run its course.

texts.zh: 我们对[Target.GetName]瘟疫所作的对策已经再也藏不住了。民众现在将他们悲痛的目光转向了天上的星辰。我们已经让他们彻底敞开了思想，直面真相；接下来会发生什么，我们拭目以待。
texts.en: Our response to the plague on [Target.GetName] can no longer be concealed. The population now turns their grief-stricken gaze to the stars. We have opened their minds to the truth; what happens next remains to be seen.

texts.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头。先知的年代已经终结，一批主流的宗教开始蓬勃发展。随着人们对意义感有了新的任务，对星球的重建工作也开始有序开展。
texts.en: At last, the plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course. The age of prophets has come to an end, and a number of major religions are flourishing. With a renewed sense of meaning, the people have begun to rebuild.

texts.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头。军阀的年代已经终结，一批战士社会开始蓬勃发展。出于对能活下来的感激之情，人们开始希望领袖们能够施加强有力和有决断力的统治。
texts.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course. The age of warlords has come to an end, and a number of warrior societies are flourishing. Grateful to be alive, the people look to their leaders for strong and determined rule.

texts.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的努力，我们已经成功地遏制了瘟疫对[Target.GetName]能造成的最坏影响。然而，我们存在于这颗星球上的真实本质再也无法掩盖了。人们明白他们是被另一颗星球所拯救。他们充满了感激之情，将目光转向了星空。
texts.en: Through diligent effort, we have succeeded in curbing the worst effects of the plague on [Target.GetName]. However, the true nature of our presence on the planet can no longer be concealed. The population understands they have been saved by another world. Filled with gratitude, they turn their gaze to the stars.

texts.zh: 瘟疫对[Target.GetName]能够造成的最严重的影响已经得到控制。然而，幸存者非但没有感激之情，反而对前来污染他们文化的“恶魔般的外来者”充满了义愤填膺。我们的救助人员遭到了针对和污蔑，因此被迫放弃了这个行星。虽然还没有完全意识到真相，但当地居民现在把紧张的目光转向了头顶的星辰。
texts.en: The worst effects of the plague on [Target.GetName] have been contained. However, far from gratitude, the survivors are filled with righteous anger at the 'demonic outsiders' who arrived to pollute their culture. Targeted and stigmatized, our aid workers have been forced to abandon the planet. While not yet fully aware of the truth, the local population now turns a nervous gaze to the stars.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成，现在必须做出选择：这项研究的成果应该仅应用于我们的统治阶层，还是全体民众？增加我们领袖的寿命当然是一个有吸引力的方案，但心怀感激的民众也有自己的好处。
texts.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete, and a choice must now be made: should the benefits of this research be applied exclusively to our ruling class, or the population as a whole? Increasing the longevity of our leaders is certainly attractive, while a grateful populace carries blessings of its own.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成。这样的知识当然是有益的，但现在必须做出选择：这项研究的成果应该仅应用于我们的领袖阶层，还是集体中的每一个子个体？
texts.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete. This knowledge will certainly be of benefit, but a choice must be made: should we apply it exclusively to our leaders, or to every drone in the collective?

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成。这样的知识可以给[Owner.GetName]带来好处。
texts.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete. This knowledge can now be applied to benefit the [Owner.GetName].

label.zh: 我们的领袖能够长盛不衰。
我们的人民要放在首位。

texts.zh:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的探险家在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上发现了一种以前未曾见识过的软体类物种。就其本身而言，这些生物中的每一个都只能勉强算得上是有智慧的。然而，当两个或更多的生物个体通过身体接触结合在一起时，它们会形成一个半意识的节点。理论上，这些节点应该能够在认知能力方面有指数级的增长。

简单地说，[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的人们偶然发现了一种生物思维机器。假以时日，这一发现可能预示着有机奇点的到来。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
texts.en:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] explorers on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have discovered a previously unknown species of molluscoid. On its own, each of these creatures barely qualifies as sapient. However, when two or more are joined through physical contact, they form a semi-conscious node. Theoretically, these nodes should be capable of an exponential growth in cognitive power.

Simply put, the people of [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have stumbled onto a biological thinking machine. Given time, this discovery could herald the advent of an Organic Singularity.

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really afford to stand by and watch?

texts.zh:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的探险家在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上发现了一种以前未曾见识过的软体类物种。就其本身而言，这些生物中的每一个都只能勉强算得上是有智慧的。然而，当两个或更多的生物个体通过身体接触结合在一起时，它们会形成一个半意识的节点。理论上，这些节点应该能够在认知能力方面有指数级的增长。

简单地说，[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的人们偶然发现了一种生物思维机器。假以时日，这一发现可能预示着有机奇点的到来。
texts.en:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] explorers on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have discovered a previously unknown species of molluscoid. On its own, each of these creatures barely qualifies as sapient. However, when two or more are joined through physical contact, they form a semi-conscious node. Theoretically, these nodes should be capable of an exponential growth in cognitive power.

Simply put, the people of [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have stumbled onto a biological thinking machine. Given time, this discovery could herald the advent of an Organic Singularity.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的居民没有意识到迫在眉睫的危险，继续试验最近发现的节点意识，将其计算结果用于从建筑到教育的各个方面。

减缓他们的进展是很困难的一件事，但是通过在行星的水循环中引入一种经过基因强化的病毒，我们应该能够减少单个节点的认知能力。

当然，与任何未经测试的技术一样，这么做存在着未知的风险。
texts.en:
Unaware of the looming danger, the inhabitants of [Target.GetName] continue to experiment with the recently discovered nodal consciousness, making use of its calculations in everything from architecture to education.

Slowing their progress will be difficult, but by introducing a genetically-augmented virus into the planet's water cycle, we should be able to reduce the cognitive power of the individual nodes.

Of course, as with any untested technology, there are unknown risks.

texts.zh:
通过坚持不懈的试验，[Target.GetName]的人民已经开始使用最近发现的节点意识作为基本的思考机器。

现在，这些居民能够完成复杂的数学计算，正以前所未有的速度在科学和技术方面取得突破。
texts.en:
Through persistent experimentation, the people of [Target.GetName] have begun to use the recently discovered nodal consciousness as a rudimentary thinking machine.

Now capable of completing complex mathematical calculations, the inhabitants are making breakthroughs in science and technology at a previously unheard of pace.

texts.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上实现有机奇点的进展十分迅速。

节点意识已经重新组织了星球上的大部分农业生产，提高了作物产量，改善了生活条件。人们已经开始把他们的决策权委任给生物机器了。
texts.en:
Progress towards an Organic Singularity on [Target.GetName] continues apace.

The nodal consciousness has reorganized much of the planet's agricultural production, increasing crop yields and raising standards of living. Already, the people are relinquishing their decision-making to the biological machine.

texts.zh:
我们在[Target.GetName]上的特工已经将修改过的病毒引入了该行星的水系统。初步报告显示，结点意识的处理能力明显下降。

不幸的是，我们的所作所为引起了注意：一些居民开始低声议论“外部”在施加影响。
texts.en:
Our agents on [Target.GetName] have introduced the modified virus to the planet's water system. Initial reports indicate a marked reduction in the processing power of the nodal consciousness.

Unfortunately, our efforts have not gone unnoticed: some of the inhabitants are beginning to whisper about 'outside' influences.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的节点意识的接口已达到饱和点。所有的官僚决策都被委托给这个有机的蜂巢意识，其成果是相当瞩目的。

这个行星的经济正在蓬勃发展，人们如今实现的生活水平，上一代人甚至想都无法想象得到。
texts.en:
Interface with the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] is reaching a saturation point. All bureaucratic decisions have been delegated to the organic hive mind, and the results are nothing short of spectacular.

The planet's economy is booming, and the people have achieved a standard of life that would have been unthinkable even a generation ago.

texts.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上，高等水平的意识出现了第一次悸动。然而，很明显，这个节点意识可能有自己的规划宏图。

为了努力“精简”流程，某些基本设施已经被削减。曾经由人工完成的工作越来越自动化，而当地政府发现自己无法（或不愿意）阻止变化的浪潮。

许多居民对他们的星球正在发生的事情越来越感到不安。
texts.en:
The first stirrings of an advanced level of consciousness have appeared on [Target.GetName]. However, it has become obvious that the nodal consciousness may have its own designs.

In an effort to 'streamline' processes, certain basic amenities have been curtailed. Jobs that were once done by hand are increasingly automated, and local government has found itself unable (or unwilling) to stem the tide of change.

Many of the inhabitants are increasingly uneasy about what is taking place on their world.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的节点意识的增长已经稳定下来。现在很清楚，奇点不会在这颗星球上实现。

然而，快速的技术变革已经将[Target.GetName]提升到完全的超光速状态。政府特工旋即夺取了星系并拆除了我们的观察站。
texts.en:
The growth of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has stabilized. It is clear now that the Singularity will not be achieved on this world.

However, rapid technological change has elevated [Target.GetName] to full FTL status. Government agents wasted no time in seizing the system and dismantling our Observation Post.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的节点意识的增长已经稳定下来。技术和社会生活的进步已经从以前的飞速发展中放缓。

现在很清楚，奇点不会在这颗星球上实现——相反，一个完全相互联系的社会已经发展起来，而且这是一个享有广泛的健康和其他物质利益的社会。
texts.en:
The growth of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has stabilized, and advances in technology and social life have slowed from their formerly breakneck pace.

It is clear now that the Singularity will not be achieved on this world - instead, a fully interconnected society has developed, and one that enjoys widespread health and other material benefits.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上出现了奇点。

经过多年的指数式增长，今天节点意识已经彻底获得了心智，并不失时机地巩固了其权威。随着行星上的人们沦为傀儡状态，大部分人已被迫屈从。他们现在只为蜂巢思维效力了。
texts.en:
The Singularity has arisen on [Target.GetName].

After years of exponential growth, today the nodal consciousness achieved full sapience and wasted no time solidifying its authority. With the planet's population reduced to puppet status, many have been forced into subservience. They now exist to provide for the hive.

texts.zh:
我们在[Target.GetName]上促进奇点形成的工作已经得到了回报。

到目前为止，整个行星几乎完全网络化了，大部分的日常决策都交给了节点意识。然而，为了“精简”流程，某些基本设施已经被取消了，行星上的人们越来越清楚地看到，他们的软体类机器可能有自己的规划宏图。
texts.en:
Our work to promote the Singularity on [Target.GetName] is already paying dividends.

By now, the planet is almost entirely networked, with much of the day-to-day decision-making given over to the nodal consciousness. However, in an effort to 'streamline' processes, certain basic amenities have been eliminated, and it is growing increasingly clear to the planet's people that their molluscoid machine may have its own designs.

texts.zh:
我们对[Target.GetName]上的节点意识进行了基因修饰，这导致这个物种无法继续作为高级智能的载体。可以肯定的是，奇点已经被阻止了。

虽然当地居民中仍然有许多人继续使用互联的软体动物进行计算，但其他人已经发现，这些生物是极好的蛋白质来源。
texts.en:
Our genetic modification of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has rendered the species useless as a vector for advanced intelligence. It is safe to conclude that the Singularity has been prevented.

While many in the local population continue to use the linked molluscoids for calculation, others have found that the creatures make excellent source of protein.

texts.zh:
我们对[Target.GetName]上的节点意识进行了基因修饰，这导致这个物种无法继续作为高级智能的载体。不幸的是，在供水中引入一种新的病毒的举措产生了意想不到的并发症，首先蔓延到当地的动物群，然后蔓延到这颗星球的所有有心智的人口。

虽然我们成功地防止了一个奇点级事件的出现，但毫无疑问，我们已经对一个新兴的社会造成了不可挽回的损失。
texts.en:
Our genetic modification of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has rendered the species useless as a vector for advanced intelligence. Unfortunately, the introduction of a novel virus to the water supply has had unexpected complications, first spreading to the local fauna, and then to the planet's sapient population.

While a Singularity-level event has been successfully prevented, there is no doubt we have caused irreparable damage to a burgeoning society.

texts.zh:
奇点已经在[Target.GetName]上濒临降生了。在其飞升后的几个小时内，蜂巢思维就已经吸收了行星上90%以上的人口，剩下的少数个体也已经在被追杀。

我们见证了一个奇点意识的诞生。
texts.en:
The Singularity has dawned on [Target.GetName]. Within hours of its ascension, the hive mind had absorbed more than 90% of the planet's population, and the few individuals who remain are already being hunted down.

We stand witness to the birth of a singular consciousness.

texts.zh:
我们一直在监测的局势突然有了结论。

宇宙中唯一不变的是变化。无论好坏，变数早晚会出现。
texts.en:
The situation we have been monitoring has come to an abrupt conclusion.

The only constant in the universe is change. For good or ill, it is only a matter of time before some new development arises.

texts.zh:
在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
texts.en:
Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really afford to stand by and watch?

texts.zh: 在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
texts.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

texts.zh: 对于[Target.GetName]的叛军而言，前路渺茫。在[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]鼓舞人心的领导下，护统军已经夺取了星球上大多数人口中心的政权。统一由铁拳铸成。任何异见都被迅速镇压。
texts.en: For the rebels on [Target.GetName], the future appears grim: under the inspired leadership of [Target.Owner.GetRulerName], pro-unification forces have seized power in most of the planet's population centers. Unity is imposed with an iron fist. Any dissent is swiftly crushed.

label.zh: 增加我们对叛军的援助。
label.en: Increase our aid to the rebels.

label.zh: 我们可以增加对护统军的援助。
label.en: We can do more more to aid the pro-unification forces.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]烽火连天，护统军和叛军继续互相厮杀。在这场斗争中，武器和战术无所不用其极，双方都犯下了累累罪行。
texts.en: Battles rage on [Target.GetName], where pro-unification and rebel forces continue to tear one another to pieces. In this struggle, no weapon or tactic is off-limit, and atrocities have been committed on both sides.

label.zh: 叛军比以往任何时候都更急需我们的援助。
label.en: The rebels need our help now more than ever.
Increase support to the pro-unification forces.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上内战频仍，护统军即将取胜。

然而在前线的大后方，当地的官员们却在绞尽脑汁地中饱私囊。目前虽然压制住了异见，但当地民众并非没有注意到腐败问题。
texts.en:
As the civil conflict continues to rage on [Target.GetName], pro-unification forces are on the brink of victory.

However, far from the front lines, local governors are seizing every opportunity to enrich themselves. For now, criticism remains muted, but the corruption has not gone unnoticed by the local population.

texts.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，护统军和叛军之间的战争已收敛成小打小闹。随着前线的巩固，双方的地方军阀都在通过贪腐来中饱私囊。这对冲突进程的影响，还有待观察。
texts.en: On [Target.GetName], the war between pro-unification and rebel forces has slowed to a murderous grind. With front lines entrenched, local warlords on both sides are enriching themselves by means of graft and corruption. How this will affect the course of the conflict remains to be seen.

label.zh: 派遣特工，使政权合法化。
label.en: Have our agents legitimize the regime.

texts.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上，腐败和地方领袖的无能引发了动荡，这促使民众转而支持叛军的事业。

在星球的主要中心城市里，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]已命令军队逐街开展一系列残酷的镇压行动以铲除异己。
texts.en:
The instability caused by corrupt and ineffectual local leaders on [Target.GetName] has galvanized public support around the rebels' cause.

In the planet's major urban centers, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has ordered their troops to carry out a series of brutal, street-by-street incursions to weed out the resistance.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上腐败猖獗，领袖无能，打消了民众对战争的支持。双方的将领都被迫开展治安战以压制民众的不满。
texts.en: The increasingly corrupt and ineffectual local leaders on [Target.GetName] have diminished popular support for the war. On both sides, military generals have been forced into anti-insurgency campaigns to quell civilian unrest.

texts.zh:
纵览[Target.GetName]，叛军节节败退，而[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]稳坐江山。

然而，即便新的世界秩序仍在酝酿，但裂痕已然出现。高官与元勋相互倾轧；贪婪的朝臣游走于权力场。

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]即将在全新的战场上接受考验。
texts.en:
Across [Target.GetName] rebel forces are in retreat, and [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] reigns supreme.

However, even as a new world order is taking shape, fractures have begun to appear; high-ranking officials pit themselves against victorious generals, and profit-hungry courtiers stalk the halls of power.

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName] is about to be tested on a whole new battlefield.

texts.zh: 没有任何一方能掌控[Target.GetName]，这导致整颗星球深陷混乱。地方军阀争权夺利，社会运动此起彼伏。只要星球上旷古未有的动荡不止，和平就只会是黄粱一梦。
texts.en: Given the failure of any one group to seize control of [Target.GetName], the planet has descended into chaos. Local warlords vie for power, and increasingly radical social movements spring up overnight. As the planet continues through the greatest upheaval in its history, peace remains a distant dream.

texts.zh: 厌恶于星球上高官的堕落和腐败，[Target.GetName]的人民已揭竿而起，与叛军同仇敌忾。革命之火在每一座小镇和村庄蔓延。
texts.en: Decrying the decadence and corruption of the planet's highest officials, the people on [Target.GetName] have risen up in solidarity with rebel forces. In every town and village, the fires of revolution burn.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上动荡不安。

涣散的军队在乡间游荡，饥渴难耐。在首都，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]继续称王，但如日西山，圣旨难出宫门。

除非发生重大转机，否则护统军败局已定。
texts.en:
On [Target.GetName] chaos reigns.

Disorganized bands roam the countryside, desperate for food. In the capital, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] clings to power, but with a diminished authority that barely extends beyond the palace gates.

Unless something radical changes, the pro-unification forces appear headed for defeat.

texts.zh:
[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]运筹帷幄，粉碎了星球上的反抗势力。在叛军阵营潜伏的特工发起了一场遍及全球的联合突袭。不等叛军将领回过神来，阵地悉数失守。

[Target.GetName]现在是个大一统的星球。
texts.en:
In a stunning display of strategy, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has crushed the planet's resistance. Sleeper agents in the rebel ranks precipitated a coordinated and planet-wide attack. Before the rebel generals knew what was happening, their positions were overwhelmed.

[Target.GetName] is now a unified world.

texts.zh:
事态急转直下，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]被废黜。

叛军与政权内几个投机的将军结盟，成功地发动了一次遍及全球的联合袭击。不等护统军指挥官回过神来，阵地悉数失守。

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]戴着镣铐在首都游街示众，旋即被处决。获胜的叛军赋予星球各地自治权。经过多年的战争，脆弱的和平终于降临。
texts.en:
In a stunning turn of events, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has been deposed.

Aligning themselves with several opportunistic generals within the regime, rebel forces succeeded in launching a coordinated, planet-wide attack. Before the pro-unification commanders knew what was happening, their positions were overwhelmed.

Paraded in chains through the streets of the capital, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] was quickly executed. The victorious rebels have granted the planet's regions the authority to dictate their own affairs. After years of war, a tenuous peace has descended.

texts.zh:
[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]被废黜。

这个前军阀戴着镣铐在首都游街示众，旋即被处决。获胜的叛军赋予星球各地自治权。经过多年的战争，脆弱的和平终于降临。
texts.en:
[Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has been deposed.

Paraded in chains through the streets of the capital, the former warlord was quickly executed. The victorious rebels have granted the planet's regions the authority to dictate their own affairs. After years of war, a tenuous peace has descended.

label.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们可能会怀念[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]。
label.en: In time they may come to miss [Target.Owner.GetRulerName].

texts.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[Target.GetName]上。由于没有天生的免疫力，也没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
texts.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Without natural immunity or the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人们偶然发现了一个新型的物种。这是一种具有处理复杂行动的能力的节点意识，与这种生物的开展互动最终可能会导致有机奇点的出现。
texts.en: The people on [Target.GetName] have stumbled across a new type of species. A nodal consciousness with the ability to handle complex operations, interacting with this creature may eventually result in the advent of an Organic Singularity.

texts.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
texts.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.
